en.name: Meat Cuts
en.subtitle: A guide to the parts of pork, beef and chicken — where each comes from and how to cook it.

zh.name: 肉品部位
zh.subtitle: 豬、牛、雞各部位介紹——來自哪裡、又該怎麼料理。

en.name: Pork belly
en.desc: Alternating layers of fat and lean from the underside. Stays succulent through long cooking — the classic choice for red-braised pork (滷肉), Dongpo pork, and hot-pot slices.

zh.name: 五花肉
zh.desc: 豬腹部、肥瘦相間的層次肉。耐久煮而不柴，是滷肉、東坡肉與火鍋肉片的經典首選。

en.name: Pork shoulder (butt)
en.desc: From the upper shoulder, finely marbled and forgiving. Slice for stir-fry and grilling, or braise for char siu and pulled pork.

zh.name: 梅花肉
zh.desc: 豬上肩部位，油花細密、不易煮老。切片快炒、燒烤，或滷成叉燒、手撕豬肉皆宜。

en.name: Pork neck (Matsusaka pork)
en.alt: 松阪豬 / 雪花豬頸肉 / 黃金六兩肉
en.desc: From the two sides of the cheek by the neck — only two slabs per pig, each about 200–300 g (roughly six taels, hence "golden six taels"). Evenly marbled and crisp-tender, the prize of the shoulder-neck. Slice thin and cook fast — pan-fry, grill, or blanch and dip in sauce; never braise or long-cook, which toughens it.

zh.name: 松阪豬
zh.alt: 雪花豬頸肉 / 菊花豬 / 雪紋豬
zh.desc: 位於豬頰兩側，每頭僅約兩片、每片 200～300 克（約六兩），故稱「黃金六兩肉」。油花均勻、口感脆嫩，是肩頸肉中風味最好的部位。宜切薄片快煮——乾煎、燒烤或川燙後沾醬；忌久燜久煮，以免肉質變硬。

en.name: Pork cap
en.alt: 霜降僧帽肉 / 老饕肉 / 離緣肉 / 二層肉
en.desc: A thin cap over the front of the loin, extending down from the neck to between the shoulder and loin — only two slices per pig. Frost-like marbling, exceptionally tender and sweet; best sliced thin for shabu-shabu or a light sear, and not long-cooked.

zh.name: 僧帽肉
zh.alt: 霜降僧帽肉 / 老饕肉 / 離緣肉 / 二層肉
zh.desc: 覆蓋在里肌（里脊）前端的薄層肉，自豬頸往下延伸至肩部與里肌之間，每頭僅取兩片。霜降油花、極為鮮嫩甘甜；切薄片涮煮或乾煎最能展現，不宜久煮。

en.name: Pork shoulder triangle
en.desc: A triangular cut between the front leg and the shoulder, part of the same shoulder-neck group. Lean with a light marbling and a crisp bite; slice thin and pan-fry, grill, or blanch and dip — don't overcook.

zh.name: 翅仔肉
zh.desc: 位於豬前腿與肩頰之間、呈三角形，同屬肩頸肉。瘦中帶油、脆嫩有咬勁；切薄片乾煎、燒烤或川燙沾醬皆宜，避免久煮。

en.name: Pork loin
en.desc: The long, lean muscle along the back — mild and firm. The cut for pork chops, tonkatsu cutlets, and braised pork-chop rice (排骨飯).

zh.name: 大里肌
zh.desc: 背脊上的長條瘦肉，肉質緊實清爽。炸豬排、煎里肌、排骨飯都用這塊。

en.name: Pork tenderloin
en.desc: The slender muscle beneath the loin — the leanest and most tender. Cooks fast; best roasted whole or sliced for quick stir-fries.

zh.name: 小里肌
zh.desc: 里肌下方的細長肌肉，最瘦也最嫩。熟得快，整條烘烤或切片快炒皆宜。

en.name: Pork ribs
en.desc: Rib bones with meat between, sweet on the bone. For rib soup (排骨湯), steamed spare ribs, and sweet-and-sour ribs.

zh.name: 排骨
zh.desc: 帶肉的肋骨段，帶骨更鮮甜。煮排骨湯、粉蒸排骨、糖醋排骨都靠它。

en.name: Pork hock & trotter
en.desc: Skin, tendon and collagen-rich meat from the leg. Turns silky and sticky braised low and slow — peanut pork trotters, braised hock.

zh.name: 蹄膀／豬腳
zh.desc: 腿部富含膠質的皮、筋與肉。慢火滷煮後軟糯黏口，花生豬腳、滷蹄膀必備。

en.name: Ground pork
en.desc: Minced shoulder or leg — the all-purpose base for dumplings, meatballs (獅子頭), minced-pork rice (肉燥), and stuffings.

zh.name: 絞肉
zh.desc: 多由肩肉或腿肉絞成，用途最廣。包水餃、做獅子頭、炒肉燥、做餡都靠它。

en.name: Beef shank
en.desc: The hard-working shin muscle threaded with tendon. Braises into firm, glossy slices — the star of soy-braised shank and beef noodle soup.

zh.name: 牛腱
zh.desc: 小腿運動肌，筋肉交織。滷煮後切片彈韌透亮，是滷牛腱與牛肉麵的主角。

en.name: Beef brisket (flank)
en.desc: Fatty, connective belly and breast meat. Needs long stewing to melt — for red-braised beef noodle soup and tomato beef stew.

zh.name: 牛腩
zh.desc: 帶筋帶油的腹胸肉，需久燉才化口。紅燒牛肉麵、番茄燉牛肉的靈魂。

en.name: Ribeye
en.desc: Richly marbled muscle from the rib — juicy and full-flavored. The go-to pan or grill steak.

zh.name: 肋眼
zh.desc: 肋脊部位、油花豐富，多汁濃郁。是煎烤牛排的首選。

en.name: Tenderloin (filet)
en.desc: The lean inner muscle that barely works — the most tender of all. Cook to medium-rare; quick sear or roast.

zh.name: 菲力
zh.desc: 幾乎不運動的內裡瘦肉，全牛最嫩。建議三至五分熟，快煎或爐烤。

en.name: Striploin (NY strip)
en.desc: Firm, beefy loin with a fat cap on one edge — balanced chew and flavor. A classic steakhouse cut.

zh.name: 紐約客
zh.desc: 腰脊部位、邊緣帶油脂，肉質緊實牛味足。嚼勁與風味均衡的經典牛排。

en.name: Short rib
en.desc: Heavily marbled rib-end meat. Superb grilled (Korean galbi) or braised until spoon-tender.

zh.name: 牛小排
zh.desc: 肋骨末端、油花密布。炭烤（韓式排骨）或燉至軟爛皆出色。

en.name: Chuck (flat iron)
en.desc: Shoulder cut with a line of gristle down the middle — affordable and flavorful. Slice for hot pot, or sear as flat-iron steak.

zh.name: 板腱
zh.desc: 肩胛部位、中央有一條筋。實惠又夠味，切片涮火鍋，或當板腱牛排香煎。

en.name: Beef short plate (belly)
en.desc: Thin, fatty belly muscle. Shaved paper-thin for hot pot, yakiniku, and gyudon beef bowls.

zh.name: 牛五花
zh.desc: 腹部薄層帶油的肉。刨成薄片用於火鍋、燒肉與牛丼。

en.name: Ground beef
en.desc: Minced chuck or trim. For burgers, meat sauce (Bolognese), and meatballs.

zh.name: 牛絞肉
zh.desc: 多由肩肉或修清肉絞成。漢堡排、肉醬、肉丸都用得上。

en.name: Chicken breast
en.desc: Lean white meat, low in fat and easy to overcook. Poach or pan-fry gently for salads, shredded chicken, and chicken rice.

zh.name: 雞胸肉
zh.desc: 低脂的白肉，最怕煮過頭。輕煎或低溫水煮，用於沙拉、手撕雞、雞肉飯。

en.name: Chicken thigh
en.desc: Juicy dark meat that stays tender. The cut for crispy chicken cutlet (雞排), teriyaki, three-cup chicken, and braises.

zh.name: 雞腿肉
zh.desc: 多汁的腿部紅肉，久煮仍嫩。炸雞排、照燒、三杯與滷雞都用這塊。

en.name: Drumstick
en.desc: The lower leg on the bone — forgiving and flavorful. Fried chicken, soy-braised, and roast.

zh.name: 棒棒腿
zh.desc: 帶骨的下腿部位，不易乾柴。炸雞、滷味、烤雞都合適。

en.name: Chicken wings
en.desc: Skin-rich and gelatinous. Fry, grill, or glaze — honey-garlic wings, salt-and-pepper, stuffed wings.

zh.name: 雞翅
zh.desc: 皮多、膠質豐富。油炸、燒烤或裹醬皆宜——蜜汁雞翅、鹽酥、糯米雞翅。

en.name: Chicken tenderloin
en.desc: The slim strip under the breast — even more tender. Great for chicken strips, nuggets, and quick stir-fries.

zh.name: 雞里肌
zh.desc: 雞胸下方的細條肉，更為軟嫩。做雞柳、雞塊與快炒最方便。

en.name: Whole chicken
en.desc: The whole bird. Roast or steam (Hainan chicken, drunken chicken), or simmer for stock and chicken soup.

zh.name: 全雞
zh.desc: 整隻雞。烤雞、白斬／海南雞、醉雞，或熬高湯與雞湯。

en.name: Chicken gizzard
en.desc: The muscular stomach — firm and crunchy. Braised in soy (滷味) or stir-fried with basil and ginger.

zh.name: 雞胗
zh.desc: 結實脆口的胃部肌肉。滷味必備，或與九層塔、薑片快炒。
